subject: pharmacology
title: Laxatives, antidiarrhoeals and drugs for inflammatory bowel disease

steps.tx: Drugs for **constipation** work through four main strategies that students should separate clearly. **Bulk forming** fibres swell inside the bowel and enlarge the stool, while osmotic agents hold water inside the lumen. Stimulant drugs provoke colonic contraction, and softeners or secretagogues ease the passage of stool. The prescriber must first exclude obstruction and then match the mechanism to the cause, because opioid effect and pelvic floor dysfunction respond quite differently.
steps.say: Drugs for constipation work through four clear mechanisms that you should learn to separate. Bulk forming fibres swell inside the bowel and they enlarge the stool for easier passage. Osmotic agents hold water inside the lumen and stimulant drugs provoke colonic contraction when needed. You must exclude obstruction first and then match the chosen drug to the underlying cause.

vis.alt: Diagram showing four types of laxative mechanisms in the colon: bulk-forming, osmotic, stimulant, and softener/secretagogue, illustrating their effects on stool and water.
vis.caption: Four strategies for constipation relief targeting different mechanisms

steps.tx: **Osmotic laxatives** form the backbone of treatment for chronic constipation in most patients. **Macrogols** hold water isotonically inside the bowel and they cause minimal disturbance of electrolytes. Lactulose ferments to acids inside the colon and it also traps ammonia, so clinicians use it for hepatic encephalopathy. Magnesium salts act quickly but they endanger patients with kidney failure, while senna and bisacodyl rescue impaction when osmotic treatment alone stalls.
steps.say: Osmotic laxatives form the backbone of treatment for chronic constipation in most patients today. Macrogols hold water isotonically inside the bowel and they cause minimal electrolyte disturbance overall. Lactulose is fermented to acids inside the colon and it traps ammonia in hepatic encephalopathy. Magnesium salts act quickly but they endanger patients whose kidneys have started failing.

steps.tx: **Antidiarrhoeals** slow intestinal transit so the bowel absorbs more water from the stool. **Loperamide** activates peripheral mu opioid receptors and it causes no central effects at normal doses. Codeine slows the gut as well but it adds central effects and dependence risk for patients. Clinicians must never slow the gut during invasive infection or colonic dilatation, because bloody diarrhoea and toxic megacolon make antimotility drugs dangerous. Oral rehydration remains the treatment that actually saves lives.
steps.say: Antidiarrhoeal drugs slow intestinal transit so the bowel absorbs more water from the stool. Loperamide activates peripheral mu receptors and it causes no central effects at normal doses. Codeine also slows the gut but it is associated with sedation and dependence risk for patients. You must never slow the bowel during invasive infection or dilatation because the colon can perforate. Oral rehydration remains the treatment that actually saves lives in acute diarrhoea.

steps.tx: Treatment for **inflammatory bowel disease** suppresses mucosal immunity in a stepwise manner for patients. **Mesalazine** delivers topical treatment in ulcerative colitis and it forms the maintenance backbone there. Steroids induce remission during flares but they do not maintain remission over time. Thiopurines and methotrexate maintain immunomodulation slowly, while biologics and small molecules heal the mucosa in moderate to severe disease. Clinicians screen for tuberculosis before anti tumour necrosis factor therapy starts.
steps.say: Treatment for inflammatory bowel disease is directed at mucosal immunity in a stepwise manner for patients. Mesalazine delivers topical treatment in ulcerative colitis and it forms the maintenance backbone there. Steroids induce remission during flares but they never maintain remission over longer periods. Biologics and small molecules heal the mucosa when disease remains moderate or severe. You must screen for tuberculosis before anti tumour necrosis factor therapy starts.

steps.tx: This endoscopic image shows **continuous disease** that starts in the rectum and extends proximally without skip areas. The mucosa looks red and granular because the normal **vascular pattern** has disappeared completely. The surface bleeds on contact and it shows the **friability** that examiners love to describe. This pattern supports ulcerative colitis rather than Crohn disease, and it explains why topical and systemic anti inflammatory treatment targets the whole involved segment.
steps.say: This endoscopic image shows continuous disease that extends proximally without any skip areas visible. The mucosa looks red and granular because the normal vascular pattern has disappeared completely. The surface bleeds on contact and it shows friability that examiners love to describe. This pattern supports ulcerative colitis rather than Crohn disease in most examination stems.

steps.tx: Supportive prescribing completes gut care and it often decides safety in examination stems. **Loperamide** never substitutes for rehydration and it only provides comfort as an adjunct. **Bile acid sequestrants** treat diarrhoea after cholecystectomy, while eluxadoline and rifaximin occupy selected niches in irritable bowel syndrome. Linaclotide adds a fluid secretion option for constipation predominant disease in older patients. Blood, fever, dilatation or obstruction changes everything and it demands investigation before any gut slowing drug.
steps.say: Supportive prescribing completes gut care and it often decides safety in examination stems today. Loperamide never substitutes for rehydration and it only provides comfort as an adjunct drug. Bile acid sequestrants treat diarrhoea after cholecystectomy and they help selected patients considerably. Blood, fever, dilatation or obstruction changes everything and it demands urgent investigation first. You must investigate red flags before you prescribe any gut slowing drug.
